description: Seeded incident history and RCA learnings. Several are written from failures triggered on purpose with flagd in the OpenTelemetry Demo (see `origin`). Served by the seeded incident adapter.

incidents.title: Checkout outage after ChargeResponse field change
incidents.summary: A payment release renamed a field on ChargeResponse. Checkout kept reading transaction_id, got an empty string, and failed order placement for every customer. Frontend surfaced the error on the checkout page.
incidents.rca: The proto change was reviewed only by the payments team. Checkout is a hard dependency of payment and was not in the review. No contract check ran in CI, and checkout's generated code was not regenerated.
watch_for: Removing, renaming or renumbering fields in ChargeResponse or ChargeRequest
Checkout reads ChargeResponse.transaction_id to confirm the order; it must be regenerated and deployed first
Run the checkout trace-based tests before merging any payment contract change
checks: Add a payment ↔ checkout contract test to CI (still-open RCA action item)

incidents.title: Recommendations silently degraded for two days
incidents.summary: A change to the recommendation list logic made ListRecommendations slow and memory hungry. Frontend's fallback hid the errors, so no alert fired and the carousel was empty for two days.
incidents.rca: Frontend's graceful fallback turned a failure into missing UI. Nobody watched the recommendation error rate or response size; only a customer report caught it.
watch_for: Changes to the size or ordering of ListRecommendationsResponse
Check the recommendation latency and error panels after deploy; frontend will not page
Confirm the product page still renders recommendations end to end
checks: Compare ListRecommendations response size and latency on staging before and after

incidents.title: Cart lost for 12% of users after Valkey failover
incidents.summary: Cart treated Valkey as a cache and returned empty carts on connection errors. Checkout then placed empty orders.
incidents.rca: Valkey is the cart's system of record. The edge was classified as soft because it looked like a cache.
watch_for: Error handling around Valkey calls in cart
Checkout behaviour when cart returns empty
checks: Kill Valkey on staging and confirm cart returns an error, not an empty cart

incidents.title: Product pages 500 when product catalog returned errors
incidents.summary: GetProduct errors for one product id propagated as 500s on the product page and blocked checkout for carts containing that product.
incidents.rca: Frontend and checkout both hard-depend on product-catalog; neither had a fallback for a single bad product.
watch_for: Error paths in GetProduct
Checkout behaviour when a cart item is missing from the catalog
checks: Place an order containing a product that GetProduct fails for

incidents.title: Orders stuck after Kafka consumer lag
incidents.summary: Accounting and fraud detection fell 40 minutes behind. Checkout was unaffected because it only produces to Kafka.
incidents.rca: Consumer lag was not alerted on. Checkout's soft edge to Kafka worked as designed.
watch_for: Consumer throughput changes in accounting
Order event schema changes
checks: Check accounting consumer lag after deploy

incidents.title: Payment unreachable after service address change
incidents.summary: A config change pointed checkout at a stale payment address. Every order failed with UNAVAILABLE.
incidents.rca: No synthetic checkout ran after the deploy. Checkout has no retry on payment UNAVAILABLE.
watch_for: Payment address or port changes
Run a synthetic checkout after deploying payment
checks: Run a synthetic checkout right after deploying payment

incidents.title: Ad service CPU spike slowed product pages
incidents.summary: A targeting change caused high CPU in the ad service. Ad calls timed out; frontend dropped the ad slot and pages stayed up.
incidents.rca: Frontend's soft edge to ad held. Impact was limited to missing ads.
watch_for: Ad targeting logic changes
Ad service CPU after deploy
checks: Watch ad service CPU for 15 minutes after deploy

incidents.title: Wrong shipping cost after quote rounding change
incidents.summary: Quote returned costs in cents instead of dollars for four hours; checkout charged the wrong shipping amount.
incidents.rca: The units change was not visible in the API contract. No end-to-end order check compared totals.
watch_for: Units and rounding in quote responses
Checkout order totals in trace tests
checks: Compare checkout order totals against quote in an end-to-end test

incidents.title: Confirmation emails not sent after template refactor
incidents.summary: Email service leaked memory after a template refactor and restarted in a loop. Checkout logged the failures and orders still completed.
incidents.rca: Checkout's soft edge to email held. Nobody watched the email error rate.
watch_for: Email template rendering changes
Email service memory after deploy
checks: Send a test order and confirm the email arrives

incidents.title: Currency conversion returned stale rates
incidents.summary: A caching change in currency served day-old conversion rates. Checkout charged totals that differed from the displayed price.
incidents.rca: Frontend and checkout call Convert independently; no check compared their results.
watch_for: Caching around Convert
Displayed vs charged totals
checks: Compare displayed and charged totals for a non-USD order
